Meet Nik. Meet Relevant.

From a living room
to Main Street.

Nik Ingram · Owner, Relevant Design

“I started this business in my mom’s living room with a laptop, a 24-inch vinyl cutter, and a bag of Doritos, cutting stickers for gokarts.”

Today, we operate out of a 4,000-square-foot facility with a design area, consultation space, a production area for our signage department, and a workshop for specialty products.

As the work grew, so did the family: RD Graphics for physical graphics and signage, Alley Cats for screen printing, Copy Write for business print, Relevant for design and creative work, and Rocket for websites.

One Zillion Possibilities

There’s one that
fits just right.

Even if you started today, at some point you run out of possibilities. At Relevant, we have One Zillion Possibilities because we have realized that out of all the possibilities, there is ONE that fits just right for you!

Our approach is unique in that we make things really simple. We don’t use big complicated words to describe what we do, who we are, and what you need.

We give our clients specific, tangible steps to take to accomplish their project.

Sometimes, we really do make fireworks.

The night
Columbia lit up.

It was almost Christmas, and we wanted dancing lights all over downtown Columbia. We ordered lighting controllers we had never touched before, mapped the lights, and started programming with less than 30 days to showtime.

Opening night was the first full run-through. The show led into fireworks, and the cheers from the streets made the work worth it. That experience brought together the design, signage, planning, and production that had been part of our business all along.
